name: Heart Like Burst
description: A like button where the heart pops with an elastic bounce and a ring of colorful particles bursts outward, with no images or JavaScript.
usage: Copy styles.css into your stylesheet and drop in the .hlb markup (a hidden checkbox plus .hlb__heart and .hlb__glyph spans) for each button. Tune per instance with the --hlb-size, --hlb-liked, --hlb-idle, and --hlb-ring custom properties on the wrapper.
